<translate>
<!--T:6-->
'''Videl''' is a martial artist of the Buu Saga. She is one of the Buu Saga fighters of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Otherworld Tournament|Otherworld Tournament]] and your sparring partner in the World Tournament preliminaries of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Buu Saga|Buu Saga]].
</translate>

<translate>
== In the tournament == <!--T:7-->

<!--T:8-->
Videl can be drawn as a '''contender''' in the Otherworld Tournament. Each contender seat draws a random fighter from the Buu Saga cast. The draw is revealed once everybody accepts the rules, and you only face her if she reaches your bout: fights between two NPCs are decided automatically.

<!--T:9-->
Her stats come from the tournament, not from the character: each contender draw has its own health, damage and AI tier. By default they range from 238,000 health, 9,900 melee damage and 8,840 ki damage (Smart AI) to 612,500 health, 25,800 melee damage and 23,460 ki damage (Elite AI), and contenders get 8% stronger for every round already played. Bouts end at knockout, so she isn't killed and drops nothing.
</translate>

<translate>
== Behavior and abilities == <!--T:10-->

<!--T:11-->
Videl has a single form and doesn't transform. She fights with the same kit as [[Special:MyLanguage/Shin|Shin]]:

<!--T:12-->
* '''Ki attacks:''' Ki Volley and Ki Blast, both yellow.
* '''Combos:''' none; she fights with plain melee.
* '''Mobility:''' she flies and backsteps away from your hits.

<!--T:13-->
Her AI tier comes from the tournament draw or, in the story, from your difficulty (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Sagas#Enemy AI tiers|enemy AI tiers]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story == <!--T:14-->

<!--T:15-->
[[Special:MyLanguage/Buu Saga|Buu Saga]] quest 37, ''Tournament Preliminaries'', is a spar with Videl at the World Tournament: she concedes instead of dying.
</translate>
